name: co-translator
description: Zero Native desktop realtime translator using OpenAI Realtime translation.

scripts.dev: npm run build:backend && zig build && CO_TRANSLATOR_BRIDGE_TOKEN=$(node -e "process.stdout.write(require('node:crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))") concurrently -k "node --max-old-space-size=32 --max-semi-space-size=1 dist/backend/server.js" "CO_TRANSLATOR_EXTERNAL_BACKEND=1 zero-native dev --binary zig-out/bin/co-translator"
scripts.build:backend: tsc -p tsconfig.backend.json && bun build src/backend/server.ts --target=bun --format=esm --outfile dist/backend/server.bundle.js && cd router-go && go build -ldflags "-s -w" -o ../dist/backend-go/co-translator-backend ./cmd/backend
scripts.latency:go-router: cd router-go && go test ./... && go run ./cmd/router-bench
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run stage:native
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && zig build package -Dpackage-target=macos -Doptimize=ReleaseSmall -Dtrace=off
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && zig build package -Dpackage-target=linux -Doptimize=ReleaseSmall -Dtrace=off
